change_summary: Keep historical terminal state and verified-output evidence separate from current dispatch_state/identity_status.
Readback/status failure records a sticky needs_reconcile/identity_unknown guard and preserves charged timeout/submission history.
Reservation rejects known legacy observation errors, unknown identity markers, and mismatched current dispatch identities.
Only an exact-version/latest/status/latest matched observation clears the guard; changed terminal or active status cannot reuse a prior terminal completion.
Read-only reconcile can recover a withdrawn terminal identity without a push, refund or terminal rewrite.
Retrieval readback failures also revoke current dispatch; successful retrieval alone does not clear the sticky guard.

limitations: No real provider reconciliation was authorized or attempted; the existing real submission_unknown remains unresolved.
Legacy terminal records with no error/identity marker retain prior policy; any recorded observation error or unknown marker requires reconciliation.
